title: Abra 93/165 REVERSE HOLO Expedition Base Set 2002 Pokemon e-Card Rare NM
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
Abra — 93/165 — REVERSE HOLO
English Pokémon TCG, Expedition Base Set (2002, e-Card Series)
Reverse holo — the holofoil covers the card around the artwork window. Verified in hand by tilting under light: the name bar and attack text area shift rainbow as the card moves. This is not the standard non-holo printing, which is a far more common card
Basic Psychic, 40 HP. Common rarity symbol, reverse holo treatment
Illustrated by Hajime Kusajima
e-Reader ID: B-18-# — the dot-code strip along the bottom edge is intact
Attacks: Scratch 10, Confuse Ray
Condition: Near Mint. Sharp corners, clean edges, no whitening, no surface scratches or print lines. Photographed front and back under natural light — what you see is the exact card you receive.
